[SWS_CM_10017] Deserializing incomplete data on the proxy side belonging to a field and initValue defined
⌈
If less data than expected shall be deserialized on the
proxy side and the data to be deserialized belong to a Field and the initValue is defined, the initValue shall be used as a substitute for the missing data.
